note: Consumed by scripts/vm/Invoke-APT29.ps1 (the same list is embedded there; keep them identical in technique, tests and custom, in this order). Atomic entries run Invoke-AtomicTest <technique> -TestNumbers <test_number>. Entries with custom set are benign built-in steps in the script. expected_rule is the alert each step is verified to raise on 9.5.3 (rule queries read from the stack); null means telemetry only. The steps run as SYSTEM through az vm run-command. A wmic (CommandLineEventConsumer create) and a rundll32/comsvcs MiniDump custom step were tried and removed on 2026-11-18: their literal strings tripped Windows Defender AMSI static scanning and blocked the whole script from running (ScriptContainedMaliciousContent), not just those two steps. The real T1546.003 atomic test still raises the WMI subscription alert on its own; T1003.001 (credential access) has no step in this list for now.
